summary: Public projects created on 10 April 2025: 5 repos and 8 datasets.
intro: Linux tools and AI prompt experiments filled the repositories: a Home Front Command wrapper, a list of MCP clients for Linux, and single-prompt book generation. Datasets covered system prompts for speech-to-text, careers, geopolitics, data work, email, prompt engineering, and general use.
